text: I will meet Sarah at the station tomorrow morning.
translation: Ich treffe Sarah morgen früh auf dem Revier.

text: Remember: buy 2 litres of milk, eggs & bread!
translation: Denken Sie daran: Kaufen Sie 2 Liter Milch, Eier & Brot!

text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
translation: Der schnelle Braunfuchs springt über den faulen Hund.

text: Call Dr. O'Neil at 9:30am (ask about the 'blue' file).
translation: Rufen Sie Dr. O'Neil um 9:30 Uhr an (Fragen Sie nach der "blauen" Datei).

text: Ich treffe Sarah morgen früh am Bahnhof.
translation: I'll meet Sarah at the station in the morning.

text: Vergiss nicht, die Rechnung bis Freitag zu bezahlen.
translation: Don't forget to pay the bill until Friday.

text: Remember to buy milk and call mum tonight.
translation: दूध खरीदने और आज रात को मां को फोन करने के लिए याद रखें.

text: The meeting moved to Thursday at 3 pm.
translation: सभा 3 बजे गुरुवार को शुरू हुई ।

text: कल सुबह मुझे डॉक्टर के पास जाना है।
translation: Tomorrow morning I have to go to the doctor.

text: 明日の朝、駅で会いましょう。
translation: I'll see you at the station tomorrow morning.

text: 牛乳と卵を買うのを忘れないでください。
translation: Don't forget to buy milk and eggs.

text: Don't forget the keys on the kitchen table.
translation: No olvides las llaves de la mesa de la cocina.

text: Ideas for the weekend: hike, read, sleep in.
translation: Ideas para el fin de semana: caminar, leer, dormir.
